components.name: Primary Button
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">START YOUR PROJECT <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 19 19 5M5 5h14v14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:25px;padding:19px 29px;min-height:64px;background:var(--amber,#4a3718);color:white;border:2px solid var(--gold,#efba4d);border-radius:3px;font:800 17px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-primary:hover{background:#69501f;transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-primary:active{transform:none}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-switch button:focus-visible,.ds-service a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold,#efba4d);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet utility action for prepared briefs.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-block;background:transparent;color:var(--gold,#efba4d);font:12px Inter,sans-serif;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid #8a6b32;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--amber,#4a3718)}.ds-secondary:active{background:var(--amber,#4a3718)}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-switch button:focus-visible,.ds-service a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold,#efba4d);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview:
A dark, confident studio identity built from heavy uppercase statements, warm gold emphasis and restrained navy layers. The established visual direction adapts the user's original visual references to FORGE's own website services.

Generous section spacing lets assertive headlines lead; compact supporting text and thin rules keep the long page orderly. Components feel firm and precise, with small corners and little decorative depth.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy fields with warm gold signals.
Heavy uppercase display type with readable Inter copy.
Flat surfaces, thin dividers and small corners.
Consistent inline SVG arrows and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Gold Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve gold for emphasis and action; retain navy as the dominant field.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use heavy uppercase Switzer for statements and readable Inter for explanations.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and borders for studio containers.

dos: Do preserve the navy/gold hierarchy and uppercase display voice.
Do use consistent inline SVG arrows for action cues.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced motion.
Do place project metadata beneath its title.
donts: Don't add general container shadows to this flat system.
Don't replace SVG action arrows with text glyphs.
